title: pyrrosia rupestris
intro: Pyrrosia rupestris, commonly known as Rock Fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering numerous health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions. The bioactive constituents of Pyrrosia rupestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-cancer properties, and anti-diabetic effects. The therapeutic actions of Pyrrosia rupestris also include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
